summary: Russian forces conducted strikes on civilian and industrial targets, including a strike on a private training ground in the Kyiv region that caused casualties. In Sloviansk, two aerial bombs killed five people and injured nine, damaging residential buildings and a Latvian consulate. Ukrainian naval forces have achieved NATO interoperability status for mine countermeasures.
key_points: Russian forces launched two aerial bombs at Sloviansk, resulting in five deaths and nine injuries (Source: @UkraineNow/82886).
A strike on a private training ground in the Kyiv region caused casualties and targeted defense industry representatives (Source: @UkraineNow/82899).
The Ukrainian Navy's 1st Mine Countermeasures Division achieved NATO Evaluation Level 2 status (Source: @UkraineNow/82881).
Russian forces reportedly struck infrastructure in the ports of Odesa, Chornomorsk, Yuzhny, and Izmail (Source: @tass_agency/386915).
The Allseeds company suspended operations in the Odesa region due to high security risks from Russian attacks (Source: @UkraineNow/82901).
Russian forces claim to have liberated eight settlements across DPR, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kharkiv regions (Source: @tass_agency/386915).
The Russian 'North' group of forces reportedly took control of Zakharovka and Ivashkino (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31886).
President Zelensky is scheduled to visit the United States on July 28 to meet with Donald Trump (Source: @UkraineNow/82872).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted strikes on civilian and industrial targets, including a strike on a private training ground in the Kyiv region that caused casualties. In Sloviansk, two aerial bombs killed five people and injured nine, damaging residential buildings and a Latvian consulate. Ukrainian naval forces have achieved NATO interoperability status for mine countermeasures.

points: In Sloviansk, a Russian strike involving two aerial bombs killed five people and injured nine, damaging ten private houses, an enterprise, and the premises of the Honorary Consulate of the Republic of Latvia (Source: @UkraineNow/82886).
A Russian strike targeted a private training ground in the Bucha district of the Kyiv region, resulting in casualties and impacting the defense industry (Source: @UkraineNow/82899).
The Allseeds company, a major producer and exporter of vegetable oil, suspended operations in the Odesa region due to extreme risks to personnel and facilities (Source: @UkraineNow/82901).
Ukrainian farmers in the Odesa region are facing falling prices for agricultural products, with wheat trading at 4,000-4,300 UAH per ton (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31894).
The 1st Mine Countermeasures Division of the Ukrainian Navy successfully passed NATO Evaluation Level 2, gaining the ability to command multinational forces (Source: @UkraineNow/82881).
The Russian Ministry of Defense claims its forces liberated eight settlements across the DPR, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kharkiv regions during the week (Source: @tass_agency/386915).
Russian forces reportedly targeted infrastructure in the ports of Odesa, Chornomorsk, Yuzhny, and Izmail (Source: @tass_agency/386915).
The 'North' group of forces reportedly took control of the settlements of Zakharovka and Ivashkino (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31886).
Russian forces reportedly took control of the settlements of Zakharovka and Ivashkino (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31886).
Two military personnel reportedly died in Belarus during a flight attempt (Source: @eRadarrua/102481).
Russian forces targeted infrastructure at the Odesa, Chornomorsk, Yuzhny, and Izmail ports (Source: @tass_agency/386915).
A Romanian F-16 fighter jet intercepted a drone that entered its airspace near the Odesa region (Source: @UkraineNow/82879).
Russian forces used three guided aerial bombs to strike a Nova Poshta cargo department in Izium, Kharkiv region (Source: @UkraineNow/82876).
There was a threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Taganrog, Rostov region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69373).
A threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches was reported from occupied Crimea (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69365).
A threat of Iskander-M/S-300 ballistic missile launches was reported from the Kursk region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69367).
New Iskander-M ballistic missiles were reportedly delivered to the Bryansk region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69370).

sections.threat_assessment: The targeting of private training grounds and defense industry sites indicates a Russian focus on degrading Ukraine's military-industrial capacity. The use of aerial bombs in Sloviansk and guided bombs in Izium demonstrates continued pressure on civilian and logistics infrastructure. The reported liberation of settlements by Russian forces suggests ongoing territorial shifts.
sections.regional_response: The Ukrainian Navy is increasing interoperability with NATO, as evidenced by the 1st Mine Countermeasures Division's successful evaluation. Diplomatically, President Zelensky is scheduled to meet with Donald Trump in the US to discuss the conflict. The US Senate is preparing to vote on a bill containing severe sanctions against Russia.
sections.intelligence_notes: The suspension of operations by major exporters like Allseeds highlights the economic impact of persistent strikes on the Odesa region. The presence of Iskander-M missiles in the Bryansk and Kursk regions maintains a high threat level for ballistic missile strikes. The targeting of logistics hubs in Odesa and Yuzhny aims to disrupt Ukrainian maritime and land-based supply lines.
